bio.text: Raja Krishnamoorthi was elected to Congress in 2016 and represents Illinois's 8th District; he serves on the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence.
He was raised in Peoria, Illinois, graduated from Princeton University with a degree in mechanical engineering, and graduated from Harvard Law School.
After clerking for a federal judge and practicing law in Chicago, he served as a Special Assistant Attorney General and as Illinois Deputy Treasurer.
